new_value: Fixed: decapsulate's match scan now evicts+skips expired entries inline (tunnel_auth.c:451-461), so a lapsed longest-prefix grant cannot shadow a live shorter-prefix grant on the same route. EXPIRED denial preserved precisely when every route+prefix match lapsed (had_expired), keeping the canonical expired_at_boundary / missing_authorization vectors intact.
